commitResults.messageBody:
Add *.class to ignore all class files in the repo
Fill blanks within AGENTS.md file

Change all occurences of previous name Duke to
Nova within the repo

Used AI feedback to abstract String values into constants
Separated greeting and farewell into individual functions

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor echo based on AI feedback
commitResults.messageBody:
Check for end of file in determining whether the loop continues
Equality check for "bye" ignores casing and blank spaces

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for list to store tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Use arrayList to store inputs from user as tasks
Print out stored tasks with command list

Remove leading and trailing whitespaces from input tasks so the list of
tasks remain neat
Account for list command when list is empty, prompt user to add tasks
Account for empty input so that no "empty tasks" get added to the list

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor with a helper to print message
commitResults.messageBody:
Add printMessage helper to reduce excessive printing of the divider
lines
New class Task. List now stores Tasks instead of the previous String

Move the parsing of input from helpers into the loop (remove duplication)
Now splits every input into two parts - command and argument
Checks for the keywords "list", "bye" now conducted on command instead
of the entire input (as in previously). An input like "bye now"
will terminate the program
Valid "mark" or "unmark" command now comes with checks for invalid
argument - out of bounds index and non-numbers

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for 3 types of task
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement 3 types of task - ToDo, Deadline, Event using inheritance from
existing Task class.
Refactor the if-else blocks within the main while loop into switches
since all of them only involve comparing the first argument of input
given by user

commitResults.messageTitle: Format printed messages when adding the Task
commitResults.messageBody:
Printing of appropriate message when adding any one of the three tasks
abstracted into a helper that is called in each of the 3 cases within
the switch. Message printed changes depending on type of task (polymorphism)
